crossRefs.note: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David…
The Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the…
“Now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that Yahweh spoke this word…
As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now…
Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease…
Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint.…
Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the…
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower…
but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

translations.web: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;
translations.bsb: Once again the Philistines waged war against Israel, and David and his servants went down and fought against the Philistines. But David became exhausted.
translations.kjv: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
translations.asv: And the Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. And David waxed faint;
